snippet.title: Dunebound Tactics | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Dunebound Tactics on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3034660/Dunebound_Tactics/

Dunebound Tactics is a roguelite turn-based tactical RPG where every decision carries weight.
Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. 

Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage, and make life-or-death choices. 

#roguelite #turnbased #indiegames
